summary: This Petition has been filed by the Petitioner, Adani Power Limited (in short, Adani), inter alia, seeking adjudication of the dispute qua PCKL/Karnataka ESCOMs’ illegal, unilateral withholding of energy charges payable to the Petitioner for the months of June and July 2021. Accordingly, through this petition, the Petitioner has sought direction against PCKL and the Karnataka ESCOMs to pay for the withheld energy charges, and associated Late Payment Surcharge (LPS) at the rate of 18%, in accordance with Regulation 59 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019. The Petitioner has made the following prayers in the instant Petition: _(d) Pass such further order as this Commission may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice._ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**2** of_ _**27**_ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**3** of_ _**27**_ 11. The Petition was heard and ‘admitted’ on 7.10.2024, and notice was issued to the parties, subject to just exceptions. 12. The matter was further listed for the hearing on 7.1.2025. On the request of the learned counsel of the Karnataka ESCOMs, the Commission permitted them to file their respective replies in the matter. (i) By delaying disclosure of the revised price, the Petitioner secured inclusion in the Merit Order Dispatch (MOD) for June and July 2021. Had UPCL disclosed _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**8** of_ _**27**_ (n) The Petition also suffers from inordinate and unexplained delay. The disputed costs relate to 06.08.2021, and the Respondent’s final decision was communicated on 22.4.2022 following the 68th Board Meeting. Yet, the Petition was filed only on 8.5.2024, with no satisfactory explanation. Such delay and laches further weaken the claim. 15. During the hearing, the learned counsel for both the Petitioner and Respondent (PCKL) made detailed arguments. The Commission, after considering the submissions, directed the Petitioner to submit the additional information. In compliance, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 15.3.2025 has submitted the information called for. _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**11** of_ _**27**_ (e) The Petitioner had intentionally withheld the revised bills sent by the M/s Glencore because if the same had been produced without a delay of 46 days, then the Petitioner would not have qualified for MOD and subsequently, power would not have been scheduled from the Petitioner. _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**12** of_ _**27**_ 18. The Petitioner, in its rejoinder dated 13.5.2025, has mainly submitted as under: 19. Based on the submissions of the parties that the pleadings and arguments have been completed in the matter, the Commission reserved its order in the Petition. 20. We have considered the rival submissions of the parties and perused the documents available on record. The main issue that arises for our consideration is whether the Petitioner, Adani Power Limited, is entitled to recovery the revised energy charges for the months of June and July 2021 arising from the final coal price communicated by M/s Glencore International under the Coal Supply and Purchase Agreement (CSPA), and whether such costs are recoverable under the terms of the PPA and the applicable provisions of the Act, 2003 and CERC Terms and Conditions of Tariff _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**14** of_ _**27**_ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**15** of_ _**27**_ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**16** of_ _**27**_ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**17** of_ _**27**_ (d) _**On Merit Order Dispatch (MOD):**_ MOD is prepared by BESCOM on the 7[th] of each month based on the previous month's invoices and communicated to SLDC Karnataka for implementation. _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**18** of_ _**27**_ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**19** of_ _**27**_ _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**21** of_ _**27**_ 48. Petition No. 220/MP/2024 is disposed of in terms of the above discussions and findings. _Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2024 Page_ _**27** of_ _**27**_
